main_text.p: קִיקָיוֹן m. Vomitus ignominiosus, quasi com-positum ex קִיא & קִיּוֹן [?].
קוֹת Expectare. Pihel קִוָּה Idem. Niphal נִקְוָה Confluere, Congregari.
קַו m. Linea, Delineatio, Regula, Amussis, Filum mensorium.
מִקְוֶה m. Expectatio, Spes: Confluens, Con-fluentia, Congregatio. Fem. מִקְוָה Idem.
קוּט Fastidire, Fastidio habere. Niphal נִקּוּט Fastidio esse. Hithpahel הִתְקּוּט [?] Fastidio torquere se.
קוֹל m. Vox, Sonus, Sonitus: plural. קוֹלוֹת Soni, Voces, quod etiam de Tonitruis dicitur.

קוּם Surgere, Insurgere: Stare, Existere. Consistere, Subsistere. Pihel קִים & קוֹמֵם Surgere, Stare fecit, Erexit, Stabilivit, Statuit. Constituit, Praestitit. Hiphil הֵקִים Idem: Confirmavit, Stabilivit, Suscitavit, Excitavit. Hophal הוּקַם Erectus fuit.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew forms in the Hiphil/Hithpahel lines are doubtful and marked [?]. The page number and running head are read from a faded scan.
